# Method as V5_FALCON_redocheck_20261021T065345Z_v002: own ruler; disc = tip-to-tip widest rim (rotation sweep -20..+20, thresholds 0.5/0.6/0.7) plus a hand row-profile where the shirt interferes; spire/disc = spire tip to the rim line / disc width (ref C41-020 ~0.55, band 0.41-0.69). Ink = ink/local-skin luminance ratio and stroke, vs the neck blaster in the same frame, tolerance |delta| <= 0.08. Ghost = old-ink and v002-ink pixels not covered by new ink vs local skin, plus a 4x/autocontrast visual. Edge = seam vs ring gradient.
# Outside-chest rule (V_1 clarification): vs the ORIGINAL frame, outside the change bbox+10 px; FAIL if 25+ px total are >12/255. Reported per row as max and count.
# C04-001 and C04-008 not rechecked here (separate re-audit). C42-ramp-landing-022-v002 has landed and is included.

# Summary: 2 PASS (C02-011, C05-010), 8 FAIL. C02-014: chest fixed but the frame fails on JPEG re-save loss (318 px). C02-015 left-rim ghost; C42-022 ink too light (borderline); C04-003 tall spires; C04-010 beam ghost + leak; C04-011 small disc + leak; C04-013 and C04-015 chest OK but re-save leak (154 / 31 px). Four of the eight are leak-only or leak-plus fixes that a single save from the original pixels would cure.
